nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 4b — services the agent's extract_clickup_task custom-tool call from Execute Agent Session's retained loop. IN: clickup_task_id (the agent's tool input — what task's attachments to extract), caller_user_id (the triggering user; set by n8n, never the agent), clickup_scope ('scoped'|'degraded', for the token-presence guard). OUT: { status, tool_result_content_json (a user.custom_tool_result content[] — text + image file_id blocks the agent SEES), new_warnings_json, new_images_json:'[]' }. Branch-free terminal (Return re-reads Merge Result). saveDataSuccessExecution=none so U's REST token is NOT persisted in this workflow's execution data.

nodes.name: Get REST Token
nodes.notes: Read the caller's CLASSIC ClickUp REST OAuth token from Supabase Vault via SECURITY DEFINER getter public.get_clickup_rest_token(clickup_user_id) (migration 042; caller_user_id IS the clickup_user_id the pipeline carries). This is the identity that lets read-input fetch the task AS U (the as-U mode, Block 4a). onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so an un-onboarded user (null token) or a transient DB miss still flows to Has Token? (-> degrade, never throw into the session). Returns { token } (null when the user has no stored REST token).

nodes.name: Has Token?
nodes.notes: TRUE (main[0]): the caller has a stored REST token -> Read Input as-U fetches the task under the caller's permissions. FALSE (main[1]): no token -> Build No Token Result degrades (extraction unavailable). CRITICAL: the FALSE branch must NEVER reach the bot path — there is no bot fallback for extraction, so a tokenless call simply returns 'unavailable' (the boundary holds).

nodes.name: Read Input as-U
nodes.notes: Call Read Input (v1) in AS-U mode (Block 4a): pass the caller's REST token as as_user_token so its Get Task (as U) fetches the task with the CALLER's identity. ClickUp denies any task the caller cannot see -> read-input returns a clickup-asU/access-denied warning (Build Extract Result turns that into an access-denied tool result). NEVER the bot token. onError=continueRegularOutput so a read-input failure degrades to a tool result rather than throwing into the session. Returns { blocks, clickup_task_id, warnings }.

nodes.name: Upload Images
nodes.notes: Upload any IMAGE blocks read-input returned to the Files API via Upload Input Images (v1), reusing the exact input-image path (fetch pre-signed URL -> POST /v1/files purpose=agent -> file_id). The spike proved a user.custom_tool_result with an image file_id block is SEEN by the agent. input_images_json = read-input's image-typed blocks (same {type:image,ref,mime,source_ref,alt,order} shape Upload Input Images expects). onError=continueRegularOutput so an upload failure degrades to a text marker per image (Build Extract Result), never throws. Returns { file_map:[{ok,file_id,url,source_ref,order,...}], warnings }.

nodes.name: Build Extract Result
nodes.notes: Assemble the user.custom_tool_result content[] the agent reads. Access-denied (read-input warning clickup-asU/access-denied) -> a denied tool result, NO alert (the boundary working is EXPECTED). Otherwise: blocks sorted by order -> text blocks verbatim (incl. [BRAK..] extraction markers), image blocks -> {type:image,source:{type:file,file_id}} matched from the upload file_map by order/source_ref/ref (a failed upload -> a text marker). A header line summarizes counts. Real (non-denied) read-input + upload warnings ride out as new_warnings_json (surfaced once by the session's Classify Alert -> Post Alert). new_images_json='[]' (extracted images are consumed by the agent, not produced output files).

nodes.name: Build No Token Result
nodes.notes: Token-presence guard + degrade. No REST token for this caller -> extraction is unavailable; answer the agent so it proceeds on existing context (never the bot view). WARN only when clickup_scope==='scoped' (the user IS onboarded for discovery but is MISSING the REST token = a half-onboarded inconsistency the operator must fix). For 'degraded' (un-onboarded) suppress the WARN — Block 2 already fired one consolidated scope-degraded WARN at session create (operator decision 2026-06-23, mirrors Block 3a).

nodes.name: Merge Result
nodes.notes: Converge the extraction result (input 0) and the no-token degrade (input 1) into ONE stream. Append; exactly one branch executes per call. Return re-reads this node so the result is deterministic.

nodes.name: Return
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL. Re-reads Merge Result's first item (research-the-web return-determinism idiom) and returns the handler contract { status, tool_result_content_json, new_warnings_json, new_images_json } that Execute Agent Session's Build Extract Result Text consumes.
